title: WOM Marketing: A Guide to Harnessing Word of Mouth | Extole

facts.fact: The article was originally published on May 30, 2020, under the byline of Chris Duskin.
The article was last updated in August 2026.
The page defines word of mouth marketing as the practice of customers sharing information about a product or service they love with their friends or family.
facts.quote: Word of mouth marketing is when customers share information about a product or service they love with their friends or family.

facts.fact: The page attributes the pioneering of WOM marketing (WOMM) most commonly to psychologist George Silverman.
facts.quote: A psychologist named George Silverman is most commonly attributed as the pioneer in the field of WOMM.

facts.fact: In an anecdote attributed to George Silverman, skeptics' opinions of a drug were swayed by a positive endorsement from one or two of their peers.
facts.quote: skeptics' opinions of a drug were swayed witha positive endorsement from one or two of their peers.
